book.name: 2Timoteo
book.title: 2Timoteo Timoteo veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa Aheuḡa

content: Keriso Iesu veize Gaueꞌeteꞌe Utiḡa Vazeḡa Manoḡa
Timoteo, eḡe ubude, Keriso Iesu teite tiburanadu aniꞌa ḡae mazao fureneꞌeteꞌe manoḡaḡa zamaḡano inaroꞌi.

Eḡe ihore ḡoeꞌa igiroteꞌe azaḡa ḡehaḡa mazaonoꞌo ḡae zuni eḡe ihore ḡoeꞌa igiro. Ḡaeꞌa igiroteꞌe ihoreḡa ḡoeꞌa eꞌe iniu zamaze niduꞌa hina gaueꞌeteꞌe azaḡa mazao ihozoꞌi, ꞌougine zeḡe zuni vaze ꞌahogaꞌahoga ihozogaꞌe idaraꞌuma.
Ḡaꞌe Keriso Iesu veize utiteꞌeteꞌe uti vazeḡa manoḡa radu emeḡe teite ḡae zuni aduga moꞌi.
Uti gauḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa gau nunu veize mada mene hauḡeꞌohe, mazaḡa aniꞌe uti vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa matuꞌohanoga veize uti gauḡa faine haḡaoga urateꞌohe.
Iniu araho goroḡa mene hegote haḡaeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe naeḡa manoḡa mene hideꞌohe.
Hihi azaḡa inare gaueꞌeteꞌeꞌa hiriviroteꞌe ogomuḡa ibite hidiꞌuma.
Eḡeꞌa raꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌa ꞌahi faine zamaroꞌi, mazaḡa Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa ḡaꞌe ḡoere eꞌe huga niduꞌa faine ederifine danaꞌiꞌuma.
Eḡeꞌa haramiroteꞌe hariḡa manoḡa idunaḡano, Davida mariga zu rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano bare iḡuniroteꞌe vazeḡa, Iesu Keriso zamaroꞌi.
Eḡeꞌa hari manoḡa haramiroteꞌe uꞌano, e ḡonore vazeḡa teige ḡuꞌa neḡano mae ohohadu aduga hideꞌohe. Rehano Badiꞌa ḡoereꞌe ḡuꞌa neḡano ꞌuogaꞌe mene idaḡa.

Eꞌanoꞌo Badiꞌaꞌa ohotiroteꞌe azaḡa veize e ḡau niduꞌa moneo zamahe obone giganeꞌohe. ꞌOugadu zeḡe zuni Keriso Iesu mazao fiadu ḡabone hidiꞌuma ebu ane teite ḡihiꞌa hune rae raꞌenaꞌa, radiu tuḡutuḡiꞌuma.
Ḡoere ꞌahiꞌe huga:

content.text: Emeꞌa aduga niduꞌa zamaḡano zamafe obone giganine,
Emeꞌa ani mazao mene fine zuni,
aniꞌa zamaḡa niduꞌa hina haḡae onamiꞌuma,
mazaḡa aniꞌe iḡaiḡa duduḡa radu ane ḡoitore ḡoeꞌa oꞌonogaꞌe mene idaḡa.

content: Badiꞌaꞌa mae Ḡihineꞌeteꞌe Gau Vazeḡa
Eꞌa ḡaꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌa ꞌadi ekalesia azaḡa bare ihozoꞌi. Ḡoere uꞌano mene rotetoga veize Badiꞌa ubumao riḡa iraduguzoꞌi. Rotetoꞌe huga oꞌoꞌa, ebu eꞌe igiꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe ruizeꞌohe.
Ḡaꞌe Badiꞌa ḡoere huga duduḡano ihozoꞌi zu ḡauni ꞌahoga moneo ago mazagaroꞌoꞌi. Ebu Badiꞌaꞌa mae ḡihineꞌeteꞌe gau vazeḡano rouga veize zamaḡo niduꞌa hina inaroꞌi.
Badiꞌa mene gubaneꞌenaꞌa, huga oꞌoꞌa ḡoeꞌa ḡoereꞌeteꞌe azaḡa mazaonoꞌo vaḡinoꞌi, mazaḡa ze ḡoere ꞌuguḡa raꞌenaꞌa, Badiꞌa mene ufeta gubaniꞌuma.
Zeḡe ihoreꞌe borevo ugiḡa teige ḡarihe bororanadu vaze sausauziꞌuma. Zeḡe boꞌaḡano Humenaio ebu Fileto zuni ꞌouge ihozeꞌohe.
Anianine ihore huga modadu Badiꞌaꞌa eme runeonoꞌo amahi bare ḡabofiro rae ihozeꞌohe zu vaze nuꞌa fieꞌetaꞌaꞌe zeḡeꞌa ꞌueꞌohe.

Rehano Badiꞌa ḡoere hugaꞌe ne gadoḡa riḡa teige edau gigaruꞌohe, ebu eꞌe rana ꞌahige rae mirihiro, “Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌe ane vaze edeḡa,” zu “Iniu Zuhiꞌa Boro hegoteꞌohe rae raꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa sauꞌanonoꞌo ḡihuriꞌuma.”

Ne boro manoḡanoꞌe mene golo siuvaḡa zu siliva siuvaḡa daꞌo, rehano ire siuvaḡa zu raha siuvaḡa zuni eꞌe. Golo siuvaḡa zu siliva siuvaḡaꞌe mada boroboro veize maꞌohe, ebu ire siuvaḡa zu raha siuvaḡaꞌe mada niduꞌa veize maꞌohe.
Iniuꞌa sauꞌa modadu ane bare dehenine, siuva manomano teige, ne vazeḡaniꞌa ani avo teadu gau manoḡa nunu haḡaifine ruhibiꞌuma, ebu aniꞌe ne vazeḡa veize gau vazeḡa manoḡa reꞌuma.

Ḡaꞌe tahiꞌa iziganiꞌa haḡaihi raꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa sauꞌanonoꞌo vaḡinoꞌi. Ebu zama deheḡa hina Zuhiꞌa Boro mazao umideꞌeteꞌe azaḡa teite, Badiꞌa ubumao haḡai duduḡa haḡaoga, Keriso mazao fioga, vaze zamaroga zu zama roḡeḡa veize inaroꞌi.
Kauriḡa zu huga oꞌoꞌa taꞌiroḡano ago ꞌauḡoꞌi, mazaḡa ḡa edeḡa, eꞌe uꞌano rotetoꞌa fureruꞌohe.
Zuhiꞌa Boro tuḡure vazeḡaꞌe vaze teite mene rotetiꞌuma, vaze niduꞌa mazao manoḡa haḡaiꞌuma, faine ihoziꞌuma, zu aduganonoꞌo zamaḡa obone tiꞌuma,
ebu ani hezahohauꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zuni zama manoḡa hina ihoziꞌuma. ꞌOugine, Badiꞌaꞌa zeḡe zamao gauadu zeꞌe haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo ḡihuriꞌuma ebu Badiꞌaꞌa ibitozeadu ḡoere huga ederiꞌuma.
Diaboloꞌa zeꞌe ꞌahirizeadu ze aniꞌa urateꞌeteꞌe gauḡa haḡaifine ibitoziro, rehano Badiꞌaꞌa danazadu ze zamare bariꞌuma ebu Diabolo mazaonoꞌo feraꞌuma.
